subject: MAP: procurement owners, evidence & close cadence (NorthLight)
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@northlight.health>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@northlight.health
Date: 2026-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement timeline + evidence list for MSA/DPA/order form

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Procurement is ready to move toward signature but we need a short mutual action plan that maps owners and target dates for the MSA, DPA, and the order form. High level asks from our side:

- Confirm which team provides SOC2 evidence and a short summary (just the attestation page and scope)
- DPA: confirm if Redwood accepts our standard subprocessors list or if you need a vendor-by-vendor disclosure timeline
- Order form: we will send our PO template, need to know who will be the signatory (legal or sales) and whether you require any payment terms edits
- Proposed close: NorthLight is aiming for legal signature + PO by week of 2026-06-14 to align with our budget cycle

Could you send a 1-page MAP that lists owners, evidence delivery dates, and the acceptance window? Also flag any blockers on your side that would prevent the 06/14 close.

Attaching our procurement intake form for reference.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Procurement Manager
NorthLight Health
[Attachment: northlight_procurement_intake.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@northlight.health>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-31T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement timeline + evidence list for MSA/DPA/order form

Elena — thanks for the clarity and the timeline. Attaching a first-draft MAP and our standard MSA (redwood_msa_v2.docx) so we can converge quickly. High level commitment from Redwood:

- Owner assignments (first pass)
  • Chloe Martin — commercial owner: coordinates order form, pricing, signing cadence; primary contact for PO questions
  • Laura Bennett — legal owner: handles MSA redlines and DPA review
  • Markus Klein — finance/sales ops: validates pricing, billing terms, and PO acceptance
  • Grace O'Connor — CS/onboarding: defines acceptance window and pilot success criteria post-signature

- Evidence delivery expectations
  • SOC2 summary (attestation page + relevant controls): we will share by 2026-06-04 (security team) [Attachment: soc2-report-summary.pdf]
  • Encryption & key management details: short doc by 2026-06-06

- Proposed cadence to hit your 2026-06-14 goal
  • 06/04 — Redwood shares SOC2 summary and MSA redline baseline
  • 06/07 — NorthLight returns PO template / any payment-term asks (we can accept net-30 by PO)
  • 06/09 — Legal aligns on redlines; final MSA/DPA handed to signatories for signature
  • 06/14 — Target: signed MSA + DPA and PO in our system; activation scheduled the week of 06/21

Potential blockers we see: any non-standard DPA clauses requiring long vendor review (e.g., bespoke data residency restrictions) or requested changes to our standard indemnity clauses might push the legal loop beyond 06/09. If that comes up, we will propose a narrow acceptance window (e.g., sign MSA with a DPA amendment to follow within 30 days) — happy to discuss tradeoffs.

Elena, please confirm who at NorthLight will sign the PO and whether the procurement team needs the PO to land before legal signs the MSA. I can update the attached MAP to reflect your responses.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Sr. Account Executive — Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood_msa_v2.docx, soc2-report-summary.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Re: Procurement timeline + evidence list for MSA/DPA/order form

Chloe / team — quick legal note after an initial pass on redwood_msa_v2.docx:

- MSA: we can accept the majority of NorthLight's redlines; main negotiation points will be: limitation of liability (we can propose a middle ground cap tied to 12 months of fees), and data breach notification SLA (we'll offer our 72-hour notification with escalation path)
- DPA: our standard DPA is compatible with subprocessor disclosures. If NorthLight requires full vendor-by-vendor prior approval, that will take longer than your 06/14 target. Recommend: accept standard DPA with a short transition clause to list subprocessors within 14 days post-signature
- Order form / PO: Markus, confirm whether net-30 PO acceptance is ok; if accounting requires any specific PO fields (GL codes, cost center), we should capture them now so the PO template doesn't create delays

Action items for this thread (internal):
- Laura to produce a 1-page redline summary and DPA recommendation by 06/04 EOD
- Markus to confirm billing/PO fields by 06/03 midday
- Grace to draft the acceptance criteria and pilot window to include in the MAP by 06/06

If all that lands on time, Chloe's proposed cadence looks achievable. I also recommend we keep a fallback: sign MSA + DPA standard and accept PO within 7 business days post-signature if procurement needs that as the official finance trigger.

Laura Bennett
Legal Operations — Redwood Inference
[Internal note: SOC2 doc is production-ready; security will sign off on the summary tomorrow]

Chloe — thanks for the quick MAP and the suggested owners. Confirming from procurement side:

- PO signatory: our finance director (signs POs); procurement will upload a scanned PO once the final order form is agreed.
- We will send the PO template attached — please confirm it can be consumed by your billing team.
- Close target: NorthLight will circulate the PO to our approvers the week of 2026-06-07 and we are aiming for your proposed 06/14 signature date.

Owners confirmed on our end:
- Elena Park — procurement lead (coordinates PO and internal approvers)
- Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@northlight.health> — finance director (PO signatory)

We reviewed the DPA note and prefer the subprocessor disclosure within 14 days approach if that expedites signature. We are comfortable with SOC2 summary + fill-in for subprocessors post-signature as you suggested.

Forwarding our PO template now. If Redwood can confirm SOC2 summary arrives by 06/04 and legal redline summary by 06/04, procurement will keep 06/14 as the target.

Thanks — I'll check back when the PO is ready.

Elena Park
